svg.title: How one node becomes poses and neighbour slots
svg.desc: Animated: node 8 (headings [0, 90], rotation allowed) and node 9 (heading [90]) from the Pecos YAML, their poses after GetAllowedHeadings, an AGV at each pose, and the eight PoseNeighbor slots that pose_graph.cpp fills for them.
svg.metadata: ["Two YAML entries. W8 at (30.8823, 12.7753) lists headings [0\u00b0, 90\u00b0] and rotation_allowed true; W9, 6.30 m to the east, lists [90\u00b0] and may not rotate. Both are XL waypoints.", "GetAllowedHeadings (pose_utils.cpp) emits Wrap(h) and Wrap(h + 180\u00b0) for every listed heading and sorts: W8 gets four poses, \u221290\u00b0, 0\u00b0, 90\u00b0, 180\u00b0; W9 gets two, \u221290\u00b0 and 90\u00b0. These are poses_[14..17] and poses_[18..19] of the 60 Pecos poses.", "What a heading means for the AGV. At (W8, 90\u00b0) the body +x axis, the AGV's long side and driving (locomote) axis, points west: heading 90\u00b0 = facing west. Its right side (body \u2212y) points north; moving sideways is a strafe. GeometricPose.yaw is the same angle in radians.", "The eight slots of (W8, 90\u00b0). pose_graph.cpp subtracts the heading from each edge's atan2 bearing as if the heading were a math angle (0\u00b0 = east), so the slot names are not the AGV's own directions: FORWARD is W13 (north, the AGV's right), LEFT is W31 (west, its real forward), BACK is W4 (its left), RIGHT is W9 (its back). ROT_RIGHT is (W8, 0\u00b0), ROT_LEFT (W8, 180\u00b0); no VRC, so VRC_UP and VRC_DOWN stay \u22121.", "The same node at heading \u221290\u00b0: the AGV faces east, so every name flips. FORWARD is now W4, BACK W13, LEFT W9 (the AGV's real forward) and RIGHT W31; ROT_LEFT is (W8, 0\u00b0) and ROT_RIGHT (W8, 180\u00b0). The neighbours are the same nodes, reached through different slots.", "(W8, 0\u00b0) and (W8, 180\u00b0) are stepping stones. No neighbour of W8 allows 0\u00b0 or 180\u00b0, so these poses get rotation slots only. They turn a 90\u00b0 to \u221290\u00b0 flip into two 90\u00b0 steps; without 0\u00b0 in the YAML, ROT_LEFT and ROT_RIGHT would both be one 180\u00b0 spin.", "The names describe the helper frame, not driving. FORWARD and BACK are travel out of the AGV's right and left sides: GarageGraph types them STRAFE. LEFT and RIGHT are along body +x and \u2212x: LOCOMOTE, the AGV's normal driving. W9 shows it: (W9, 90\u00b0) FORWARD is the 0.61 m strafe north onto charger C10, LEFT is the drive west to W8; it has no rotation slots.", "Summary for Pecos: 26 nodes with one heading give 2 poses each, W8 and W22 give 4: 60 poses and 480 slots, of which 164 are filled (148 translations, 16 rotations, no VRC). GarageGraph turns each filled slot into one directed edge."]

g.text: RIGHT are locomotes along its driving axis (LEFT = the AGV's real forward). The bearing test uses the heading as a math angle, which
